# Rachel Lynde

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016)</sub>
- **Role:** Housewife and dressmaker  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mrs. Rachel  <sub>[v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015)</sub>; Rachel  <sub>[v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a stout, heavy-set woman who tends to waddle when she walks. She is known for sitting by her kitchen window keeping a sharp eye on the main road.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)_

## Personality

Mrs. Rachel Lynde is an outspoken, capable, and busy body who prides herself on speaking her mind without fear or favor. She is a sharp observer of local affairs who manages her own concerns and those of her neighbors with great efficiency. Though her candid remarks can be blunt and offensive to others' feelings, she considers herself well-meaning, pious, and experienced in practical life.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c9 P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)_

## Traits

- Outspoken and blunt  <sub>[v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015)</sub>
- Observant and inquisitive  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005)</sub>
- Capable and efficient housewife  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Abilities

- Notable housekeeping and quilt-knitting  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>
- Managing church and local community organizations  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Goals

- To keep informed of everything happening in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005)</sub>

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde resides in Lynde's Hollow, keeping watch over the main road into Avonlea. Upon noticing Matthew Cuthbert unexpectedly driving away dressed in his best clothes, her curiosity drove her to visit Green Gables to investigate. There she learned of the Cuthberts' intention to adopt an orphan boy. When Anne Shirley arrived instead, Mrs. Rachel visited Green Gables and severely criticized Anne's freckles and red hair, triggering a furious tirade and temper outburst from the young girl. Offended, Mrs. Rachel departed after advising Marilla to use a birch switch on the child.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 c9 P15](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0015), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)_

## Background by volume

- Has raised ten children and buried two  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)</sub>
- Lives in Lynde's Hollow near the main entrance to Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001)</sub>

## Quotes

> Well, I don’t envy you your job bringing that up, Marilla  <sub>[v1 c9 P24](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0024)</sub>

> Well, I see that I’ll have to be very careful what I say after this, Marilla, since the fine feelings of orphans, brought from goodness knows where, have to be considered before anything else.  <sub>[v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030)</sub>
